title: Weather at Gale (REMS)

values.label: Surface pressure (REMS daily summary range, sols 1–4995)
values.note: Measured across 4,745 reported sols in NASA's MSL REMS feed (seasonal CO₂ cycle and diurnal thermal tides; Gómez-Elvira et al. 2014; Haberle et al. 2014).

values.label: Air temperature (1.6 m boom, daily min/max sols 1–4995)
values.note: 173 K minimum to 284 K maximum daily air temperature reported across 4,745 sols in NASA's MSL REMS feed (Gómez-Elvira et al. 2012, 2014).

values.label: Ground brightness temperature (daily min/max sols 1–4995)
values.note: 137 K pre-dawn minimum to 298 K midday maximum reported across 4,745 sols in NASA's MSL REMS feed (Martínez et al. 2017).

limits.label: Armstrong limit (human physiological threshold)
limits.source: Water boils at human body temperature (37 °C) below ~6.3 kPa; Gale pressure (679–925 Pa, above water's 611.65 Pa triple point) is ~7–9× below the Armstrong limit, requiring a full pressure suit (NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1)

limits.label: Walk-scale spatial weather map
limits.source: REMS is a single rover-local weather station on Curiosity's mast; no walk-scale spatial weather map exists

note: REMS is a rover-local meteorological station on Curiosity; no walk-scale spatial weather map or operational forecast exists for Gale Crater. Values reflect reported NASA REMS daily sol summaries.
claim_boundary: Context card only — never interpolated into per-cell route weather maps. Excursion thermal/dust windows derived from climatology are Scenario assumptions.
source: Gómez-Elvira et al. 2012, Space Sci Rev 170:583–640, doi:10.1007/s11214-012-9921-1; Gómez-Elvira et al. 2014, JGR-Planets 119:1680–1688, doi:10.1002/2013JE004576; Haberle et al. 2014, JGR-Planets 119:440–453, doi:10.1002/2013JE004488; Martínez et al. 2017, Space Sci Rev 212:295–338, doi:10.1007/s11214-017-0360-x; NASA MSL REMS Weather API; NASA PDS Atmospheres Node urn:nasa:pds:msl_rems_bundle
date_range: 2012-08-07 → 2026-08-25 (sols 1–4995, 4,745 reported sols, NASA MSL REMS feed)
